long_biography.plain_text:
Francesco De Santis transformed Italfarmaco from a nationally rooted drugmaker into an international pharmaceutical group. He opened its Spanish subsidiary in 1991, the first step in a wider expansion that established operating companies and commercial partnerships across multiple markets. His training at the University of Milan gave him a pharmacist's understanding of the products behind that growth.

De Santis also made research policy a sustained public responsibility. He has served as president and vice-president of Farmindustria and chaired its research committee, giving him a national industry platform beyond the company. He later became Confindustria's vice-president for research and development.
